# Evans Gyakye

> Author, business strategist, speaker and entrepreneur. Helps people think
> better, discover their potential, and turn ideas into purposeful action.

Evans Gyakye writes on business strategy, leadership, personal development,
entrepreneurship, faith, and African enterprise. He is the author of "27
Thoughts of a Transformer," offers business advisory services, and speaks at
conferences, corporate events, universities and leadership programmes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.evansgyakye.com/): Overview, vision, and entry points to books, writing, speaking and advisory work.
- [Books](https://www.evansgyakye.com/books.html): Books by Evans Gyakye, including "27 Thoughts of a Transformer."
- [Think](https://www.evansgyakye.com/think.html): Articles organised under Build, Become, Lead, Think, and Believe.
- [Speak](https://www.evansgyakye.com/speak.html): Speaking topics and booking information.
- [Advisory](https://www.evansgyakye.com/advisory.html): Business advisory services.
- [Projects](https://www.evansgyakye.com/projects.html): Success Factors and Yammall.
- [Contact](https://www.evansgyakye.com/contact.html): Ways to start a conversation.
